source_outcomes.NoRequest: If neither itemId>0 nor clientId>0 no ShowResult call, even if storeId>0. Parent has already Show(n) the new window. No typed NoRequest is returned.
source_outcomes.Requested: Positive item or party sets last mode and calls void ShowResult. Positive store assigns value but leaves all-store checked. Party filter additionally requires !allClients and a valid UI selection; branch/type filters are independent UI state.
source_outcomes.Empty: ActivityList.Clear precedes adapter.Fill. Zero rows or rows skipped for no InvTypes/IsInput=0 can leave an empty list; not distinguished by return value from load failure/no request.
source_outcomes.Failed: Outer catch shows a message and returns void; clearing or some row publication may already have happened. No typed failed result or parent retry contract.
source_outcomes.Partial: Loop adds result rows one by one; metadata skip or later conversion/lookup exception can leave a prefix. No health field carried to parent; lookup/SQL not executed in this audit.
source_outcomes.Denied: Generic MainClass button permission traversal is not a data-row allowed-set. No typed Denied result in LastProcess/ShowResult; does not establish absence of deployment ACL.
